program.intent: Combine date and time fields into epoch microseconds for precise and reversible timestamp storage.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    year, month, day, sp1, hour, minute, second, millis = groups
    dt_text = f"{year}-{month}-{day} {hour}:{minute}:{second}.{millis}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(dt_text, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    dt_text = dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')[:-3]
    year, month, day, time = dt_text.split(' ')[0].split('-') + [dt_text.split(' ')[1]]
    hour, minute, second_millis = time.split(':')
    second, millis = second_millis.split('.')
    return f"{year}-{month.zfill(2)}-{day.zfill(2)}{' ' * sp1_len}{hour.zfill(2)}:{minute.zfill(2)}:{second.zfill(2)},{millis}"
